cause.basis: While the replicas waited for spot GPUs to be released by preemption, the kubelet on the failed replica's node rejected the pod at admission (8 spot GPUs requested, 7 available). The pod never created a container, so no native code ran; the any-replica fail policy then closed the other replicas through rjob-controller. The only user operation is the create.

accounting.rule: D-P2-64-FIFTH: without complete container clocks, 64 GPUs x scheduled wall time counts toward 128. The window ends at the later of the last stop and the last replica event (image pull on a pod still tearing down).

not_run.cloud_copy: No container started, so no cloud output exists
